text:
Maria: Quick ask — we need a seeded posting plan for next week's webinar promo. Goal: drive registrants + high-quality demo requests. Priority channels: LinkedIn (organic + employees) and X. Can folks confirm seedlist, final creative, and UTMs by EOD PT?

Maria: Things I specifically need: 1) final hero image (1200x628 + 1 mobile crop), 2) 3 short copy variants (headline + 1-line), 3) top 10 amplifiers/handles with priority, 4) UTM pattern for landing page + slack routing for inbound leads.

Sam: On it. Pulling a prioritized seedlist from last webinar + new enterprise prospects. Will upload CSV to the marketing drive now: https://drive.redwood/example (permissions: marketing@).

Sam: Also drafting 3 copy variants, will paste them here for review in ~20m. cc @Priya for influencer handles.

Priya: I have a refreshed list of 14 amplifiers — marking top 10 with notes (time zone & preferred cadence). Pasting main handles: @ai_engineer, @prod_lead, @startup_cx, @ml_ops, @infra_guru, @founder_x, @security_cto, @cloud_sally, @data_maven, @edge_dev. Will add notes in the CSV column "priority_comment".

Alex: For the hero image — design can finish the mobile crop by EOD if we lock messaging now. Do we want the image to include webinar date/time overlay? (I recommend yes for LinkedIn thumbnails).

Jordan: Important: inbound routing — webinar registrants that come from X/LinkedIn with company size > 200 should route to SDR-enterprise queue, others to SDR-inbound. UTM parsing rule: utm_source in {x, linkedin}, utm_campaign=webinar_apr26_2026, utm_medium=social. Also add `?lead_route=webinar` param so the form backend tags properly.

Maria: Perfect — Jordan, can you paste the exact UTM pattern to include in the copy so we keep it consistent?

Jordan: Use this pattern: `https://redwood.ai/webinar-apr26?utm_source={x|linkedin}&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr26_2026&utm_content={variant}&lead_route=webinar`

Sam: Copy drafts — quick takes, pick one or request edits: 
1) "Build faster with reliable LLM inference. Join our webinar Apr 26 to see Redwood's production patterns in action. Register: <link>"
2) "Shipping LLM features? See how we cut token cost & latency in production. Webinar Apr 26 — save your seat: <link>"
3) "From prototype to scale: practical serving patterns for LLMs. Live Apr 26 — register: <link>"

Priya: Variant suggestions for employee amplification (shorter versions for X): 
- "Webinar Apr 26: LLM inference at scale. Save a seat: <link>" 
- "How we optimize LLM cost + latency — live Apr 26. Register: <link>"

Alex: Design notes: hero will include headline "LLM inference: production patterns" + date. I'll attach two crops: `webinar_hero_desktop.png` and `webinar_hero_mobile.png` to the drive folder. Alt text: "Panelists discussing production LLM inference patterns, Apr 26 webinar".

Sam: Uploaded CSV + copy to the Drive folder: https://drive.redwood/example/folder. Filename: `webinar_apr26_seedlist.csv` and `webinar_apr26_copy_v1.txt`. Permissions set to marketing view/edit.

OpsBot: Scheduler queued a draft post for review — LinkedIn employee share slot 2026-04-01 10:00 PT (requires approval): post_id=sch_9876.

Maria: Quick QA checklist before assets are finalized: 1) Confirm PNGs in drive? 2) Confirm copy variant chosen? 3) Confirm top 10 priority handles and outreach owner? 4) Confirm UTM pattern in all CTA links? 5) Confirm routing rules with @Jordan?

Priya: 1) PNGs uploaded by @Alex ✅ 2) I vote for copy variant 2 for paid ads, variant 1 for employee shares ✅ 3) Outreach owner: Priya (influencer asks) & Sam (seedlist DMs) ✅ 4) UTMs added to all links in the drive copy ✅ 5) Jordan confirmed routing rules and shared the exact pattern ✅

Jordan: I set up a quick iFTTT rule with the CDP team: when `lead_route=webinar` and company_size>200 -> tag 'SDR_enterprise' else 'SDR_inbound'. Will monitor first 3 hours post-send and report anomalies.

Maria: Amazing. Final ask — anyone who will amplify please add their employee share slot in the sheet under "employee_shares" so OpsBot can auto-schedule. Also leave your preferred post time (window).

Alex: Added employee share times (I put mine 2026-04-01 11:00 PT).

Sam: DM outreach plan: Sam -> 40 highest-priority amplifiers w/ brief ask template. Template: "Hey NAME — we're doing a short webinar on Apr 26 about LLM inference in production. Would you be open to sharing? Here's a short post you can copy/paste: [variant]." I'll start outreach tomorrow morning.

Maria: Thanks all — marking this thread as active task. If we hit blockers call it out here. Closing note: target is to have everything locked 24h before the employee share schedule. :thumbsup:

Sam: Noted — will ping if any missing handles.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Finalize webinar social assets" 2026-03-31 09:00 PT -> #marketing.

Maria: Closing update — everything confirmed, drive folder has final assets and copy. Moving to scheduled state. Thanks team! :tada:
